title: OHP Mega Demo 9000 - TRSI & DES!RE - @Party 2012
summary: A real-time demoscene production made with an overhead projector, released by DESiRE and TRSi for @Party in the OHP category. It is a short, quirky entry in the demoscene tradition.
why: Mentioned as a quirky example of demoscene creativity and related overhead-projector techniques.
